root_cause.text: In the BPF verifier's adjust_reg_min_max_vals(), when src_reg and dst_reg refer to the same register in an ALU operation like rX += rX, the delta tracking code reads the post-modification value of the source register (which was already overwritten by the in-place destination modification) instead of the original value, leading to an incorrect delta that is propagated to linked registers and causes a verifier-vs-runtime mismatch.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "the subsequent is_reg_const(src_reg)/reg_const_value(src_reg) reads the post-{add,sub} value instead of the original source." The patch adds a check `!(BPF_SRC(insn->code) == BPF_X && insn->src_reg == insn->dst_reg)` to skip delta tracking when src and dst are the same register.
